Awake<WH06974><WTH8685>, ye drunkards<WH07910>, and weep<WH01058><WTH8798>; and howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, all ye drinkers<WH08354><WTH8802> of wine<WH03196>, because of the new wine<WH06071>; for it is cut off<WH03772><WTH8738> from your mouth<WH06310>.

For a nation<WH01471> is come up<WH05927><WTH8804> upon my land<WH0776>, strong<WH06099>, and without number<WH04557>, whose teeth<WH08127> <FI>are<Fi> the teeth<WH08127> of a lion<WH0738>, and he hath the cheek teeth<WH04973> of a great lion<WH03833>.

He hath laid<WH07760><WTH8804> my vine<WH01612> waste<WH08047>, and barked<WH07111> my fig tree<WH08384>: he hath made it clean<WH02834><WTH8800> bare<WH02834><WTH8804>, and cast <FI>it<Fi> away<WH07993><WTH8689>; the branches<WH08299> thereof are made white<WH03835><WTH8689>. <RF>barked...: Heb. laid my fig tree for a barking<Rf><CM>
Lament<WH0421><WTH8798> like a virgin<WH01330> girded<WH02296><WTH8803> with sackcloth<WH08242> for the husband<WH01167> of her youth<WH05271>.

The meat offering<WH04503> and the drink offering<WH05262> is cut off<WH03772><WTH8717> from the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068>; the priests<WH03548>, the LORD'S<WH03068> ministers<WH08334><WTH8764>, mourn<WH056><WTH8804>.

The field<WH07704> is wasted<WH07703><WTH8795>, the land<WH0127> mourneth<WH056><WTH8804>; for the corn<WH01715> is wasted<WH07703><WTH8795>: the new wine<WH08492> is dried up<WH03001><WTH8689>, the oil<WH03323> languisheth<WH0535><WTH8797>.

Be ye ashamed<WH03001><WTH8685>, O ye husbandmen<WH0406>; howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, O ye vinedressers<WH03755>, for the wheat<WH02406> and for the barley<WH08184>; because the harvest<WH07105> of the field<WH07704> is perished<WH06><WTH8804>.

The vine<WH01612> is dried up<WH03001><WTH8689>, and the fig tree<WH08384> languisheth<WH0535><WTH8797>; the pomegranate<WH07416> tree, the palm tree<WH08558> also, and the apple tree<WH08598>, <FI>even<Fi>  all the trees<WH06086> of the field<WH07704>, are withered<WH03001><WTH8804>: because joy<WH08342> is withered away<WH03001><WTH8689> from the sons<WH01121> of men<WH0120>.

Gird<WH02296><WTH8798> yourselves, and lament<WH05594><WTH8798>, ye priests<WH03548>: howl<WH03213><WTH8685>, ye ministers<WH08334><WTH8764> of the altar<WH04196>: come<WH0935><WTH8798>, lie all night<WH03885><WTH8798> in sackcloth<WH08242>, ye ministers<WH08334><WTH8764> of my God<WH0430>: for the meat offering<WH04503> and the drink offering<WH05262> is withholden<WH04513><WTH8738> from the house<WH01004> of your God<WH0430>.<CM>

Sanctify<WH06942><WTH8761> ye a fast<WH06685>, call<WH07121><WTH8798> a solemn assembly<WH06116>, gather<WH0622><WTH8798> the elders<WH02205> <FI>and<Fi> all the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the land<WH0776> <FI>into<Fi> the house<WH01004> of the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, and cry<WH02199><WTH8798> unto the LORD<WH03068>, <RF>solemn...: or, day of restraint<Rf>
Alas<WH0162> for the day<WH03117>! for the day<WH03117> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> at hand<WH07138>, and as a destruction<WH07701> from the Almighty<WH07706> shall it come<WH0935><WTH8799>.
Is not the meat<WH0400> cut off<WH03772><WTH8738> before our eyes<WH05869>, <FI>yea<Fi> , joy<WH08057> and gladness<WH01524> from the house<WH01004> of our God<WH0430>?

The seed<WH06507> is rotten<WH05685><WTH8804> under their clods<WH04053>, the garners<WH0214> are laid desolate<WH08074><WTH8738>, the barns<WH04460> are broken down<WH02040><WTH8738>; for the corn<WH01715> is withered<WH03001><WTH8689>. <RF>seed: Heb. grains<Rf>

How do the beasts<WH0929> groan<WH0584><WTH8737>! the herds<WH05739> of cattle<WH01241> are perplexed<WH0943><WTH8738>, because they have no pasture<WH04829>; yea, the flocks<WH05739> of sheep<WH06629> are made desolate<WH0816><WTH8738>.

O LORD<WH03068>, to thee will I cry<WH07121><WTH8799>: for the fire<WH0784> hath devoured<WH0398><WTH8804> the pastures<WH04999> of the wilderness<WH04057>, and the flame<WH03852> hath burned<WH03857><WTH8765> all the trees<WH06086> of the field<WH07704>. <RF>pastures: or, habitations<Rf>

The beasts<WH0929> of the field<WH07704> cry<WH06165><WTH8799> also unto thee: for the rivers<WH0650> of waters<WH04325> are dried up<WH03001><WTH8804>, and the fire<WH0784> hath devoured<WH0398><WTH8804> the pastures<WH04999> of the wilderness<WH04057>.<CM>
